model_annotation: The image displays a nested donut chart comparing two sets of related metrics, with "Ambiguity Std" represented on the outer ring and "Max Ambiguity" on the inner ring. The chart consists of seven total slices: four segments in the outer ring and three in the inner ring. According to the top legend for the outer ring, the categories are represented in varying shades of blue: the darkest blue slice corresponds to "Std: 0.0" and has a partially obscured white percentage label ending in ".0%", a medium-dark blue slice represents "Std: 0.47" at 39.0%, a light blue slice indicates "Std: 0.94" at 7.0%, and a medium blue slice represents "Std: 0.82" at 5.0%. The bottom legend corresponds to the inner ring, which uses three lighter blue shades: a bright blue slice for "Max: 1" at 47.7%, a medium-light blue slice for "Max: 2" at 38.0%, and the lightest blue slice for "Max: 3" at 14.2%. Percentage labels are positioned directly inside their respective segments, utilizing white text in the outer ring and black text in the inner ring. Two corresponding legends are located on the right side of the plot. The slices do not appear to be ordered strictly by ascending or descending size in either ring. Visually, the chart features a prominent, dark shadow behind it, and a straight vertical crop on the far left partially obscures the leftmost portions of both rings and one of the outer labels.
